# Type scale

Names are the brightest text in a row. Modified time is next, and size is the
quietest so the eye lands on the filename first.

## Rows

| Part | Weight |
| --- | --- |
| File name | 100% theme text |
| Modified time | ~48% |
| Size | ~36% |
| Selected name | heading colour |

**Long names** must end in an ellipsis; metadata must stay right-aligned even
when the column is only 400 DIP wide.
